answer: Admission is a solo survey. Each new key posts a 400-token bond and sets one factory-serialized glass prism on a marked stake occupying a single named ridge already vacant in the register. After a random freeze on the open tundra, two unchosen clerks must recover the same serial from opposite bearings and file both sightings within one hour. A reused serial, a shared stake, or a missed sighting fuses the colliding keys and burns the bond. Because each plot and serial admits only one identity, a farm of aliases spends a plot and a bond for every extra name and still fails the dual sighting.
